comparison_limits: Profiler wall time includes different collection and parsing work and is not a hardware latency comparison.

The 910B4 probe used CANN 8.5.1 and must not be used to explain the historical CANN 9.1 model benchmark.
The probe validates tool invocation and output structure, not Qwen model performance.
